title: 第一卷 第75章 肥头大耳又老又丑第一卷 第74章 有没有资格入我的法眼
lines: 倘若对方只是欺压底层百姓的纨绔子弟，他根本懒得在世家大会中出手相助，任其自生自灭便是。
若他们身负真才实学、心中尚存底线道义，倒不妨结为同盟。
让本属于相兽家族猎杀人族天骄的大会，彻底化作相兽子弟的噩梦。
这时，陈渊几人的目光无意间落在了被众人追捧的花魁身上。
“我靠，那女子长得也太正点了！”
李伟再度激动出声，目光火热地紧盯楼下那花魁。
“她并不好看。”
糯米忽然开口，顿了顿又认真补充，“她的真实容貌，远不如宁姐姐好看。”
“这是魅惑神通。”
陈昭宁惊异地看向糯米，没想到小小年纪，竟能看穿女子的魅惑幻术。
她揉了揉糯米肉乎乎的小脑袋，从怀中取出一瓶药液分给众人，“都抹在眼上，便能看清她的真面目。”
“她本体是一只狐兽，依仗魅惑神通，能让所有望见她的人，都将其视作梦中情人，彻底沉沦，无法自拔。”
陈昭宁扫了一眼身旁神色各异的众人，当看到陈渊始终神色淡然，不为所动时，暗自松了口气，心底还泛起几分窃喜。
果然，这位便宜弟弟，和其他男人就是不同。
“卧槽！这比开了十级美颜还要离谱，简直判若两人！”
李伟抹上药液，看清花魁梦书书的真实容貌后，顿时倒吸一口凉气，连连做出作呕的动作。
说好的妙龄少女，竟然是个大妈假扮！
陈建明，陈建初等人见状，忍不住低声哄笑。
“走，下楼去看看。”
陈渊来了兴致，当即起身迈步走向楼梯。
众人紧随其后，一同下楼。
张山、唐虎、厉守仁三人神色倨傲，对着眼前体态肥胖、身为青楼老鸨的中年妇人厉声呵斥，执意要让对方把花魁唤来作陪。
可老鸨丝毫不给情面，根本不将三人放在眼里。
甚至放下狠话，若再执意闹事，便直接将几人赶出青楼。
“张山，眼下怎么办？临死前，都无法弄死那个花魁吗？”
唐虎望着四周一众凶神恶煞的护卫，压低声音开口。
他身形魁梧，眸光凌厉慑人。
而站在他身侧、一身黑衣的张山，身形更为壮硕，足足高出他半个头颅。
至于为何要弄死那个花魁，全然是因为他们调查到，对方是一个拐骗良家少女的毒妇。
“等等看下有没有机会动手！”
张山沉声纠正，稍作停顿，语气凝重道：“眼下局面棘手，我们没有绝对战力，也没有正当理由硬碰。”
content_en:
If the other party was just a playboy who oppressed the lower class people, he wouldn't even bother to help him in the family meeting and would just let him fend for himself.
If they have real talents and knowledge and still have bottom-line morality in their hearts, they might as well form an alliance.
The conference that was supposed to be a competition for the Xiangshou family to hunt down the geniuses of the clan turned into a nightmare for the Xiangshou children.
At this time, the eyes of Chen Yuan and others accidentally fell on the oiran who was being sought after by everyone.
"Damn, that woman is so pretty!"
Li Wei spoke excitedly again, staring at the oiran downstairs with fiery eyes.
"She's not pretty."
Nuomi suddenly spoke, paused and then added seriously, "Her real appearance is far less beautiful than Sister Ning."
"This is the magical power of charm."
Chen Zhaoning looked at Nuomi in surprise. He didn't expect that at such a young age, he could see through the woman's charming illusion.
She rubbed Nuomi's fleshy little head, took out a bottle of liquid medicine from her arms and distributed it to everyone, "Put them all on your eyes, and you can see her true face."
"Her true form is a fox beast. With her magical power, she can make everyone who sees her regard her as the lover of their dreams. She is completely addicted and unable to extricate herself."
Chen Zhaoning glanced at the people with different expressions around him. When he saw that Chen Yuan always looked calm and unmoved, he secretly breathed a sigh of relief and felt a little secretly happy in his heart.
Sure enough, this cheap brother is different from other men.
"F*ck! This is even more outrageous than turning on level 10 beauty. They are completely different!"
After Li Wei applied the liquid and saw the true appearance of the Oiran's dream book, he suddenly took a breath of cold air and made nauseating movements repeatedly.
The young girl promised turned out to be an aunt in disguise!
When Chen Jianming, Chen Jianchu and others saw this, they couldn't help but laugh in low voices.
"Let's go downstairs and have a look."
Chen Yuan became interested and immediately stood up and walked towards the stairs.
Everyone followed closely and went downstairs together.
…
Zhang Shan, Tang Hu, and Li Shouren looked arrogant and scolded the obese middle-aged woman in front of them who was a brothel madam, insisting that the other party call the oiran to accompany her.
But the madam showed no mercy at all and didn't take the three of them seriously.
He even put down his harsh words and if he insisted on causing trouble again, he would directly drive a few people out of the brothel.
"Zhang Shan, what should we do now? Can't we kill the oiran before he dies?"
Tang Hu looked at the fierce guards around him and lowered his voice.
He was tall and tall, and his eyes were sharp and intimidating.
Standing next to him, Zhang Shan, dressed in black, was even stronger, half a head taller than him.
As for why they wanted to kill the oiran, it was entirely because they found out that the other party was a vicious woman who abducted young girls from good families.
"Wait and see if there is a chance to take action!"
Zhang Shan corrected in a deep voice, paused for a moment, and said in a solemn tone: "The situation is difficult at the moment. We do not have absolute combat power, and there is no legitimate reason for a head-on confrontation."
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 75: Fat, old and ugly Volume 1 Chapter 74: Are you qualified to be in my eyes?
